note: Retailer sale dates follow each retailer's own announcement; dates marked 'expected' follow the usual pattern and are confirmed about a week before.

events.name: Pepero Day & 11.11 sales
events.why: Korea's biggest snack gifting day and the start of year-end online sales.
events.act: Snack and confectionery demand peaks; plan next year's gift SKUs now.

events.name: Olive Young Day
events.why: Monthly 3-day member sale at Korea's largest beauty retailer.
events.act: Watch which items sell out; they signal next quarter's reorders.

events.name: Olive Young Sale (year-end)
events.why: The largest of four quarterly sales; year-end gift sets and Olive Young Awards winners.
events.act: Gift-set formats launched here reach overseas 2-3 months later. Creators: haul and 'what Koreans bought' content.

events.name: Kimjang season
events.why: Households make a winter's worth of kimchi; gochugaru, salted shrimp and napa cabbage prices move.
events.act: Expect tighter supply and higher prices on gochugaru and kimchi inputs.

events.name: Seollal pre-holiday shipping cut-off
events.why: Factories, forwarders and couriers clear backlogs before the Lunar New Year shutdown.
events.act: Place orders and book freight before late January; production slots fill early.

events.name: Seollal (Lunar New Year) holiday
events.why: National holiday: most factories, customs brokers and couriers stop.
events.act: No shipping or production; expect delays for a week after.

events.name: Olive Young Sale (spring)
events.why: New-semester colour makeup and season-change skincare.
events.act: Sunscreen launches start here, months before Western summer.

events.name: Olive Young Sale (summer)
events.why: Sun care, cooling and soothing lines.
events.act: Summer bestsellers here are next year's import candidates.

events.name: Olive Young Sale (autumn)
events.why: Firming and nourishing lines, Chuseok gift sets.
events.act: Barrier and moisture categories rise into winter.

events.name: Chuseok holiday
events.why: Korea's harvest holiday; gift sets (ginseng, spam, fruit, beauty) peak in the two weeks before.
events.act: Book freight before early September; gift-set demand shows in search two weeks ahead.
